Connect via MCP to search across all your collections directly from Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and more.

Authorization.description: API key required for authentication, formatted as 'Bearer sk_live_your_key_here'. You can create an API key at https://ragora.app/settings?tab=developer

servers.name: ragora

servers.description: Enables remote server administration via SSH, supporting command execution, SFTP file transfers, and multi-profile management. It features security safeguards like destructive command detection and audit logging to ensure safe interaction with remote Linux/Unix environments.

SSH_PROFILES_PATH.description: Optional path to the profiles.json configuration file. Defaults to the local directory.

SSH_PASSWORD_STAGING.description: SSH password for the 'staging' profile defined in profiles.json.

SSH_PASSWORD_PRODUCTION.description: SSH password for the 'production' profile defined in profiles.json.

servers.name: SSH MCP Server

servers.description: Provides AI agents with real-time web capabilities including live search results, markdown web scraping, business lead generation, and detailed company information. It enables agents to bypass knowledge cutoffs by accessing current web data through a monetized Apify Actor.
servers.name: Web Intelligence MCP Server

servers.description: An MCP server that enables users to control and edit REAPER projects through a Python-based interface and a Lua bridge. It supports managing tracks, controlling transport, manipulating MIDI and audio items, and adjusting FX parameters within the digital audio workstation.

REAPER_BRIDGE_HOST.description: Bridge host for the REAPER connection

REAPER_BRIDGE_PORT.description: Bridge port for the REAPER connection

servers.name: ReaMCP

servers.description: An MCP server that enables AI models to control electronic music instruments by sending MIDI messages to hardware synths and drum machines. It supports various MIDI commands including notes, control changes, and system exclusive messages through USB or DIN MIDI interfaces.
servers.name: midi-mcp

servers.description: An MCP server that coordinates multiple Claude Code sessions through kitty terminal remote control to enable a manager-worker delegation workflow. It supports task dependency tracking, inter-agent communication, and automated status monitoring across multiple terminal windows.
servers.name: ama-mcp

servers.description: An MCP server that enables AI assistants to create and manage persistent SQLite databases through natural language without requiring SQL knowledge. It allows users to propose schemas, store records, and perform complex queries across multiple databases for structured data tracking.
servers.name: instant-db

servers.description: Provides covenant rule enforcement, hash-chained audit logs, and integrity verification for MCP-compatible agents. It enables users to define granular permission rules and maintain a tamper-evident audit trail of all actions.
servers.name: Nobulex MCP Compliance Server

servers.description: An MCP server that exposes the Horizon content aggregation and analysis pipeline as a suite of modular tools. It enables users to automate fetching, AI-based scoring, filtering, background enrichment, and summary generation for various data sources.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token used for content fetching or other integrations within the Horizon pipeline.

HORIZON_PATH.description: Path to the Horizon repository. The server uses this to locate the Horizon implementation and its data/config.json. If not provided, the server will attempt to discover it in default locations like ./Horizon or ../Horizon.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key used for AI-driven tools such as scoring (hz_score_items), enrichment (hz_enrich_items), and summary generation (hz_generate_summary).

servers.name: Horizon MCP

servers.description: MCP server for Huly (task tracker) integration

HULY_URL.description: Huly instance URL (must be valid http or https URL)

LAZY_ENVS.description: Defer client connection until first tool call ("true" or "false", default: "false")

HULY_EMAIL.description: Email for password auth (required if HULY_TOKEN not set)

HULY_PASSWORD.description: Password for password auth (required if HULY_TOKEN not set)

HULY_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT.description: Connection timeout in ms (positive integer, default: 30000)

servers.name: Huly MCP

servers.description: An MCP server that enables natural language control of Kiwoom Securities accounts through Claude Desktop. It provides tools for stock price lookup, buying and selling stocks, and analyzing portfolios or trade history via the Kiwoom REST API.

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: 전송 방식 (stdio 또는 http, 기본값: stdio)

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer 인증 토큰 (HTTP 모드 시 필수)

servers.name: kiwoom-mcp

servers.description: An MCP server that enables AI assistants to manage restic backups, including listing snapshots, browsing files, and creating new backups. It provides tools for repository maintenance, data restoration, and applying retention policies through the Model Context Protocol.
servers.name: restic-mcp

servers.description: An agent-ready TypeScript template for building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with standardized discovery flows and permission-aware tools. It provides pre-configured core and operable profiles to help developers quickly implement, test, and distribute production-ready MCP services.
servers.name: MCP Starter

servers.description: An MCP server and Telegram bot that enables natural language management of WooCommerce stores, including products, orders, customers, and sales reports. It supports multiple LLM providers, voice commands via Whisper transcription, and deployment on Cloudflare Workers.
